summary: SEALSQ Corp filed a 6-K disclosing an October 8, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger among GigCapital8 Corp., newly formed PubCo Quantisimo Holdings Corp., and merger subs, with SEALSQ and WISeQey as the Company Shareholders owning 100% of Quantisimo. SPAC Merger Sub merges into GigCapital8 first, then Target Merger Sub merges into Quantisimo, leaving PubCo as the publicly traded holdco of both. GigCapital8 holders receive one PubCo ordinary share per share; the Sponsor receives 3,035,083 ordinary and 3,035,084 Class F shares. Operating subsidiaries Miraex, SEALCOIN, WeCan, and WISeSat.Space will be contributed pre-closing. Watch GigCapital8 and Company Shareholder approvals, redemption levels, and Contribution completion.
